metadata.probeSourceNote: Every probe source here is an enrolled image (enroll-jobs takes primaries from <id>.jpg, else from a decode of thumbs/192/<id>.webp), so Tier 1 is a self-recognition and enrollment-integrity check. Held-out accuracy lives in reports/held-out-accuracy.md.
metadata.galleryEnrollmentNote: embeddings.json holds real FaceNet-128 descriptors only for the ids that ship a root JPG; the rest are random filler vectors. Probes for those identities are reported as the unenrolled cohort, not as misses.
